question: Generate 3 hero concepts for the National Day teaser

intro.title: Meet Chloe Tan
intro.text: Creative & Marketing Lead at Mediacorp. National Day eve: 42 assets ship this weekend, and her whole studio wakes up on one canvas.

hero.title: One protagonist, one countdown
hero.text: The marquee names today's protagonist — the National Day hero film. A live countdown runs to the 16:30 lock; the ring shows 31 of 42 assets shipped.

kpis.title: Numbers, no chrome
kpis.text: Four naked stats sit straight on the canvas: 38.6M reach, up 15%; 142 assets a week; S$166 per asset, down 79%; engagement 4.8%.

chart.title: What the systems see together
chart.text: One full-bleed join: SAP spend, Salesforce reach, Monday output overlaid. Reach grew 80% on just 7% more spend — four-times content velocity did the work.

ask.title: Ask for three concepts
ask.text: Chloe asks askMElah in plain language. Higgsfield renders three on-brand hero concepts in 41 seconds — NDP26 palette, Majulah lockup, 16:9 masters, premiere-safe by 18:00.

delegate.title: Delegate the shot-list
delegate.text: In the Make chapter, one click hands askMElah the job: rank 24 overnight concepts, queue motion passes, deliver Farah's shortlist 42 minutes before the 10:30.

autopilot.title: A deck that clears itself
autopilot.text: Approvals arrive as a flick-through deck. Flip Autopilot on and low-risk items — Farah's S$6,800 Adobe Stock top-up — fly off; the S$126,500 Wunderfolk SOW still waits for Chloe.

mcp.title: Wired into everything
mcp.text: The footer strip shows the wiring: Monday, Higgsfield, Adobe, Salesforce, SAP and more. Every render, number and approval traces to a real MCP call.

recap.title: Friday, in one click
recap.text: One marquee button drafts the week recap — shortlist delivered, 31 of 42 assets shipped, Grace's channel brief staged. Friday-night write-ups stop being a job.

outro.title: More craft, less chasing
outro.text: The countdown hits 16:30 with everything already locked. askMElah batches, files and chases across Mediacorp's stack; Chloe directs the craft.
